propositions: not_a_bug close without replacement link routes to completion verifier which demands proof a nonexistent defect was fixed, making truthful closes impossible without --force
not_a_bug lacks a deterministic disposition verdict because it names no replacement; verdict() returns None and fall-through occurs to full completion verification with the wrong criterion
not_a_bug and escalated must be added to REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES so verdict() mints deterministic (class, close_reason) attestations without replacement or LLM
not_a_bug with --reason but no replacement or --force must close without invoking completion verifier and must mint a signed disposition attestation
not_a_bug without --reason must be refused at write time with a named requirement, not silently routed to completion verification
